# petal-elements

> Community-maintained Material 3 Expressive web components (Lit), forked from
> material-web. Tags are `petal-*`, classes `Petal*`, CSS custom properties
> `--md-*`. Values follow Jetpack Compose. Not an official Google project.

Install: `npm install petal-elements`. Import one component per module,
for example `import 'petal-elements/button/filled-button.js'`, or everything
with `import 'petal-elements/all.js'`. Load `petal-elements/tokens/css/sys.css`
once in the page head; set `--md-ref-typeface-brand` and
`--md-ref-typeface-plain` for fonts. Icons need the Material Symbols font.

Docs are shipped in the package under `docs/`. Read the doc of a component
before using it; do not guess attributes.

## Guides

- [Using in an existing site](docs/migrating.md): steps, mapping from hand-written parts, pitfalls
- [Quick start](docs/quick-start.md): install, import, tokens, build
- [Expressive features](docs/expressive.md): sizes, shape morphing, springs, button groups
- [Tokens](docs/tokens.md): system tokens and their sources
- [Colors](docs/theming/color.md), [shape](docs/theming/shape.md), [typography](docs/theming/typography.md)
- [Theme transition](docs/theming/README.md#theme-transition): `theme/theme-transition.js`, `transitionTheme(apply, event)` for a circular light/dark switch
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)

## Components (import path, tags)

- [Button](docs/components/button.md): `button/{filled,filled-tonal,outlined,elevated,text}-button.js`
- [Button group](docs/components/button-group.md): `buttongroup/button-group.js`, `petal-button-group`
- [Icon button](docs/components/icon-button.md): `iconbutton/{icon,filled-icon,filled-tonal-icon,outlined-icon}-button.js`
- [FAB](docs/components/fab.md): `fab/fab.js`, `fab/branded-fab.js`
- [Floating toolbar](docs/components/floating-toolbar.md): `floatingtoolbar/floating-toolbar.js`, `petal-floating-toolbar`
- [FAB menu](docs/components/fab-menu.md): `fabmenu/{fab-menu,fab-menu-item,toggle-fab}.js`, `petal-fab-menu`, `petal-fab-menu-item`, `petal-toggle-fab`
- [Icon](docs/components/icon.md): `icon/icon.js`, `petal-icon`
- [Card](docs/components/card.md): `card/{filled,elevated,outlined}-card.js`
- [Dialog](docs/components/dialog.md): `dialog/dialog.js`, `petal-dialog`
- [Snackbar](docs/components/snackbar.md): `snackbar/snackbar.js`, `petal-snackbar`
- [Search bar](docs/components/search.md): `search/search-bar.js`, `petal-search-bar`
- [Bottom sheet](docs/components/bottom-sheet.md): `sheet/bottom-sheet.js`, `petal-bottom-sheet`
- [Split button](docs/components/split-button.md): `splitbutton/split-button.js`, `petal-split-button`
- [Tooltip](docs/components/tooltip.md): `tooltip/tooltip.js`, `petal-tooltip`
- [Menu](docs/components/menu.md): `menu/{menu,menu-item,sub-menu,menu-group}.js`
- [Navigation bar](docs/components/navigation-bar.md): `navigationbar/{navigation-bar,navigation-bar-item}.js`, `petal-navigation-bar`
- [Navigation drawer](docs/components/navigation-drawer.md): `navigationdrawer/{navigation-drawer,navigation-drawer-item}.js`, `petal-navigation-drawer` (`type`: modal, dismissible, standard)
- [Navigation rail](docs/components/navigation-rail.md): `navigationrail/{navigation-rail,navigation-rail-item}.js`, `petal-navigation-rail`
- [Top app bar](docs/components/top-app-bar.md): `appbar/top-app-bar.js`, `petal-top-app-bar`
- [Pull to refresh](docs/components/pull-to-refresh.md): `pulltorefresh/pull-to-refresh.js`
- [Progress](docs/components/progress.md): `progress/{linear,circular}-progress.js`
- [Loading indicator](docs/components/loading-indicator.md): `loadingindicator/loading-indicator.js`

- [Text field](docs/components/text-field.md): `textfield/{filled,outlined}-text-field.js`
- [Select](docs/components/select.md): `select/{filled,outlined}-select.js`, `select/select-option.js`
- [Checkbox](docs/components/checkbox.md), [radio](docs/components/radio.md), [switch](docs/components/switch.md), [slider](docs/components/slider.md)
- [Tabs](docs/components/tabs.md): `tabs/{tabs,primary-tab,secondary-tab}.js`
- [Chips](docs/components/chip.md): `chips/{assist,filter,input,suggestion}-chip.js`, `chips/chip-set.js`
- [Divider](docs/components/divider.md), [elevation](docs/components/elevation.md), [focus ring](docs/components/focus-ring.md), [ripple](docs/components/ripple.md)

## Machine-readable API

- [custom-elements.json](custom-elements.json): every element's attributes, properties, events, slots and CSS parts
- `.d.ts` files sit next to every `.js` module
